title: Running the county
text: McKinley County's government had about 220 full-time employees in 2022, and no part-time staff. That year it spent about 54 million dollars. It collected about 24 million dollars in taxes, about 17 million of it from property taxes and about 7 million from gross receipts and sales taxes.
